wuxue_canwuguize2.en:
1. After the learning begins, there will be a continuous flow of meditations from the character, which may become enlightenment or magic, and will automatically disappear after a period of time. 
2. According to the key prompt, press the corresponding key to collect "Wu" or "Mo", and press the ZL+ key to destroy "Wu" or "Mo" 
3. The character needs to collect Enlightenment and destroy demons, and the undestroyed demons invade the body when they disappear. The more "Enlightenment" collected, the better the learning effect, and the "Mo" collected will affect the learning effect. 5. The higher the character's understanding, the higher the probability of enlightenment.
wuxue_canwuguize2.ch:
1.学习开始后，会不断有冥思从角色体内向外溢出，这些冥思有可能会变成【悟】或【魔】，并且在一段时间后会自动消失。
2.根据按键提示按下对应的按键可收集到【悟】或【魔】，按住ZL+按键摧毁【悟】或【魔】
3.角色需要收集【悟】和摧毁【魔】，未摧毁的【魔】在其消失时会侵入体内。
4.收集的【悟】越多，则学习的效果越好，收集的【魔】则会影响学习的效果。
5.角色的悟性越高，出现【悟】的概率越高。

AppellationTitleTips1412.en: When this Taoist Title is equipped, you can neutralize all $s_mu$ damage from Cultivators of the same or lower stage for a short period of time.
AppellationTitleTips1412.ch: 佩戴此道号时，可短时间化解一切来自同阶或低阶修仙者的$s_mu$伤害。

AppellationTitlegainDesc1002.en:
Only one Cultivator in the whole world carries the Taoist Title of the Yong Ning No.1 Spear Cultivator.
If the Title is held by no one, then the mightiest Spear Cultivator among all <r>Qi Refining and Foundation Realm</r> Cultivators at <r>40</r> $s_qiang$ stats gains the Taoist Title of the Yong Ning No.1 Spear Cultivator.
If the Title has already been taken, then the Cultivator must find whomever the No.1 Spear Cultivator is and challenge them for the Taoist Title. If they succeed in this challenge, the Title will be theirs.
If neither the Spiritual Skill nor the Special Skill of a Cultivator are at Martial Arts $s_qiang$, they will not be qualified to either hold the Title or challenge others for it.
AppellationTitlegainDesc1002.ch:
八荒之内，仅有一位修仙者能拥有永宁第一枪修的道号。
若此道号无人拥有，在所有<r>炼气境、筑基境</r>的$s_qiang$资质达到<r>40</r>的修仙者中，实力最强的枪修，可获得永宁第一枪修的道号。
若此道号已被人拥有，修仙者需要找到永宁第一枪修的拥有者，并向其发起道号挑战，挑战成功后可获得永宁第一枪修的道号。
当修仙者灵技和绝技均不是$s_qiang$的功法时，则不具备获得或挑战枪修类道号的资格。

drama_dialogue2002482.en:
I always thought my father is very powerful. No matter the danger, he is not afraid and would always rise to the occasion.
He always said that he could protect the tribe and is not afraid of any danger.
But I thought that only such a person could be lauded by others.
I thought my father was the only one, but I never thought there would be you! I really want to talk to you, but I can’t now.
My father and his friends are very capable. One day you will be able to return to the world.
When that time comes, we’ll talk for three days and three nights! 


Feng Lixi
drama_dialogue2002482.ch:
我一向觉得我父亲十分厉害，无论什么危险他都不害怕，总会奋勇向前。
他总说能够保护族中，什么危难也不怕。他总让我十分担心。
但我以为也只有这样的人才能叫别人敬爱。
我以为我父亲是唯一的，没想到还有你！我真想跟你聊聊天，但现在是没办法了。
不过父亲和他的朋友本事很大，总有一日你定能回到八荒。
到时候我们再聊，聊个三天三夜！


风里希

drama_dialogue6002335.en:
Yuanqiu, on the other hand, did not seem to have any talent for cultivation. She had made no progress for three years, and it seemed her fate did not lie on the Heavenly Way.
To cheer her younger sister up, Yuanzhi promised her that she would find a way for her to increase her chances of cultivation after she joined the Sect. Yuanqiu smiled wanly, but didn't say a word.
drama_dialogue6002335.ch:
而愿求则没有半点仙根，她三年来毫无寸进，眼看与天道无缘。
为了照顾妹妹的情绪，愿知向她承诺，待自己进入宗门，一定想办法为妹妹愿求寻找提升资质之法。愿求淡然一笑，并不言语。

drama_dialogue6341005.en: "An excellent {#item_name3031101} was forged with a great forge and required materials."
drama_dialogue6341005.ch: “配合其他一些材料，凭借高超的炼器资质才炼成如此优质的{#item_name3031101}。”

drama_dialogue70097.en: To the south there is a Sacred Pond. If you can bring me some <g>Divine Water</g> from there, I will give you the <g>Mulberry Branch</g>.
drama_dialogue70097.ch: 南方有一处仙池，你若是能取得一些池中的<g>神水</g>，我便将<g>扶桑树枝</g>交给于你。

drama_dialogue760451.en: You pick up the <r>Water Dragon Cauldron</r> and exit the cave... As you make to leave a dragon-headed monster suddenly appears in the air before you.
drama_dialogue760451.ch: 你拿起<r>溟霖鼎</r>，走出了洞府外，正打算离开时…空中骤然出现了一只龙首人身的怪物。

drama_dialogue8007101.en: If you could defeat me, I'll bestow my Heavenly Art upon you. I'll only use 10% of my power in this spar, so don't worry.
drama_dialogue8007101.ch: 若汝能战胜吾，仙法将归于汝。此次切磋，吾仅会用出一成功力，汝不必紧张。

drama_dialogue8013101.ch: 战胜我的三成功力，就将仙法给你。

drama_dialogue8021201.ch: 你若能战斗我的一成功力，仙法便归你所有。
